task: Phase 2 task 012: cap configuration UI (global stepper + per-engine override)

frontend/src/pages/Settings/components/G.summary: Replaces the binary 1/2 tts_parallel_cap ToggleButton with a real numeric stepper input (1-8, MAX_GLOBAL_PARALLEL_CAP constant matching MAX_GLOBAL_CONCURRENT_SYNTHESIS backstop in app/orchestration/scheduler/resources.py:44-46), client-side clamped before calling the existing updateParallelCap raw-JSON-fetch write (unchanged POST /api/settings {tts_parallel_cap} shape).

frontend/src/pages/Engines/components/En.summary: New optional settings?: Settings prop. Adds a per-engine 'Concurrent Renders' override control reading/writing tts_engine_caps[engine.engine_id], clamped client-side to engine.behavior.max_concurrent_workers (falls back to DEFAULT_ENGINE_CAP_CEILING=8 when the manifest doesn't declare one). Save handler (handleSaveEngineCap) posts raw JSON to POST /api/settings with {tts_engine_caps: {...existing, [engine_id]: clamped}}, merging with (not clobbering) other engines' overrides — a separate write path from the existing api.updateEngineSettings (plugin's own settings_schema store, untouched). UI copy notes the change takes effect on next app restart (WarmWorkerManager cap-freeze caching, out of scope per task 014).
New optional settings?: Settings prop, threaded straight through to each EngineCard (prop-plumbing chain for task 012's per-engine cap control).

frontend/src/pages/Engines/EnginesPage.t.summary: New optional settings?: Settings prop, threaded through to EnginesPanel (same plumbing chain).

frontend/src/app/App.tsx.summary: The /engines route now also passes settings={initialData?.settings} into EnginesPage, matching the pattern already used for five other routes.

flow_impact: tts_engine_caps (already fully consumed server-side by resolve_effective_cap) now has a real frontend write path for the first time, via App.tsx -> EnginesPage -> EnginesPanel -> EngineCard prop-plumbing. No existing prop's meaning changed; all new props are optional so pre-existing callers/tests are unaffected. Global tts_parallel_cap UI range widened from {1,2} to 1-8; write mechanism (POST /api/settings JSON body) unchanged.
